text: I move from observation to inspiration—the transition from glass-encased meetings, with their silent anticipation and collective focus, to the vibrant wall celebrating Research + Development. Here thought and creation are praised openly, in color and word. I feel a current of curiosity, a sense that ideas are living things connecting us, evolving in unexpected ways. Bearing witness to both quiet collaboration and exuberant innovation, I am reminded that every mind—alone or together—shapes the world.
